guide.q01.question.value: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces?
guide.q01.question.match: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces? & Yes. In \swrBaseNullHarm\% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm \swrHarmLTwo\% (L2) to \swrHarmLThree\% (L3) of pairs. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-repeat} \\
guide.q01.question.note: number macros replaced by their generated values

guide.q01.answer.value: Yes. In 1.8–2.3% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm 4.8–5.7% (L2) to 10.2–10.9% (L3) of pairs.
guide.q01.answer.match: Is editor harm more than a repeated evaluation produces? & Yes. In \swrBaseNullHarm\% of pairs a repeated base run fails where the first run succeeded; the 112-task editors harm \swrHarmLTwo\% (L2) to \swrHarmLThree\% (L3) of pairs. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-repeat} \\

guide.q02.question.value: Do the recipe differences hold across training seeds?
guide.q02.question.match: Do the recipe differences hold across training seeds? & At 16 source tasks, L3 is below L1 and L2 in all three seeds. At 112 source tasks and 121.25k updates, L1 and L2 exceed L3 in all three seeds; L2 stays consistent (\swrThreeSrLtwoOne--\swrThreeSrLtwoTwo\%), L3 seed~2 (\swrThreeSrLthreeTwo\%) matches seed~0 (\swrThreeSrLthreeZero\%) while seed~1 is lower (\swrThreeSrLthreeOne\%), and L1 reaches \swrThreeSrLoneTwo\% in seed~2. & \ref{app:sw-robustness-seeds16}, \ref{app:sw-robustness-seeds112} \\
guide.q02.question.note: number macros replaced by their generated values

guide.q02.answer.value: At 16 source tasks, L3 is below L1 and L2 in all three seeds. At 112 source tasks and 121.25k updates, L1 and L2 exceed L3 in all three seeds; L2 stays consistent (58.11–60.28%), L3 seed 2 (46.44%) matches seed 0 (46.78%) while seed 1 is lower (34.83%), and L1 reaches 61.28% in seed 2.
guide.q02.answer.match: Do the recipe differences hold across training seeds? & At 16 source tasks, L3 is below L1 and L2 in all three seeds.
